summary: Frontend-only verification of LinkifiedText on product detail (/product/p_ashwagandha, 'Instant Henna Hair Pack'). All 4 URLs in the description (https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ, https://youtube.com/shorts/abc123XYZ, www.example.com) are rendered as tappable <span role="link" tabindex="0"> elements with color rgb(154,205,50) (#9ACD32), text-decoration underline, cursor pointer, and an onClick handler. JS-dispatched clicks confirmed Linking.openURL -> window.open fires with the exact FULL https:// URLs: 'https://youtu.be/...', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...', 'https://youtube.com/shorts/...', and 'https://www.example.com/' (bare www normalized to https). No <iframe> embedded YouTube player present — links open externally via window.open(url,'_blank','noopener'). Surrounding non-URL text ('Great herbal product!', 'Watch demo:', 'Full video:', 'YouTube Shorts:', 'Also visit', 'for details.') renders as plain non-interactive text with the normal description style. Review section (code line 168 in app/product/[id].tsx) wires the same LinkifiedText for r.comment, so review URLs will linkify identically (the seeded review 'Great stress relief!' has no URL to visually confirm, but the component is identical). No console errors related to linkification; an unrelated 401 'Missing token' appears only when the add-to-cart button is tapped (expected — cart requires auth and was not part of this review).
critical_code_review_comments: LinkifiedText uses React Native primitives (Text + onPress + accessibilityRole='link'); on react-native-web this correctly produces <span role='link'> with an attached onClick wired to Linking.openURL — matches requested behavior.

URL_REGEX in /app/frontend/src/components/LinkifiedText.tsx correctly matches https?://, www.*, youtu.be/<id>, and youtube.com/(watch?v=|shorts/)<id>; normalizeUrl prepends https:// for bare www.* which yields 'https://www.example.com' as required.

Playwright pointer-level click(force=True) sometimes misses role=link spans that are inline inside a larger Text block (the first 3 YouTube spans). JS .click() on the span correctly fires onPress and window.open for all 4 — behavior on an actual touch device/browser is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing backend seed for product p_ashwagandha.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product detail URL: /product/p_ashwagandha is publicly accessible (no auth required). LinkifiedText renders role=link spans; to verify onPress wiring in Playwright, use JS .click() on [role='link'] rather than pointer click(force=True) because adjacent inline text may win hit-testing. window.open override pattern captures Linking.openURL calls on web.
